author: haymaker116
quote:
Don't buy this slop!
The graphics are ok, everything else is absolute garbage.

Performance on base ps5 is just bad. Mostly sub 30fps and constant frame drops.

The open world is huge jet somehow less fun than in gta5. For example, you can't even get trains to run over things. The train just magically stops before impact.

The writing is just abysmal.
The awesome gta humor is gone. I don't think I even chuckled once during my entire play through.
The main story is painfully boring and never gets better. 
The main characters are extremely unlikeable. Lucia is a self-entitled imbecile and Jason is her obedient lapdog. Not a single redeeming quality among the two.

If you're on the fence, wait for the PC version and a deep discount. Maybe the modders can save this steaming pile of horse****
